answer: The pourer fills his moulds from the ladle, and the ladle must pour level or the candles come uneven. Spermaceti palm taper dipper ash writ is the pouring: a writ palm taper dippers sign after dipping room checks. The harbor is the first ladle, poured at the bench; the violet is the last, poured before the wax runs out, and the trellis is the bench itself, puddled with wax. A cheat must pour 13 false ladles and level 13 false benches.
